coffeeChat.mentorConsent:
Mentor notice and consent
· Your reviews on the boards stay anonymous. In a coffee chat, however, the other person may see your face and name.
· Mentoring comes with no reward of any kind, including points. Company referral bonuses follow each company's own program.
· You create and share your own Zoom link. Misaeng only helps you connect.
· Career advice is your personal opinion, and Misaeng is not responsible for what is said in the conversation.
· When you accept, your LinkedIn is shown to the requester.
· A coffee chat request button also appears on the interview and job reviews you wrote.
